comparison.objective: Install safety caps on exposed rebar while leaving pre-capped bars undisturbed.
comparison.physical_skill: Align and press-fit multiple caps onto vertical bars without dislodging completed work.
comparison.success_condition: All five bars have deeply seated, aligned caps; hands remain clear for 3 s.
comparison.reason: Repeated press-fit installation is materially different from separating mixed loose objects through a manipulated screen.
